title: f8wqAddons
description: simple hypixel skyblock mod for various features, getting more features in the future
body:
# f8wqAddons
A small clientside QOL mod for Hypixel Skyblock.

#### config: /f8wqaddons or /f8a

## Features:

#### Party Overlay
- Displays your current party members on screen. Draggable and resizable via the built-in HUD editor.


#### Chat Commands
- Currently only !crypt [username], sends you a clickable skycrypt link to the specified user.

#### Carry Calculator
- /f8a cc [amount] [eman/blaze] [tier] [location] Calculates carry prices for Blaze (T1-T4) and Eman (T4) using sbm's pricing, including bulk discounts and location based Eman prices.

#### Custom name
- now you can rename yourself clientside and get a cool custom gradient aswell :)
